what_changed: Annual CPI-W adjustment of the TILA/Regulation Z exempt-transaction threshold from $69,500 to $71,900 (Supplement I to Part 1026, comment 3(b)), effective January 1, 2025.
rationale: Changes which non-mortgage consumer loans Regulation Z covers, which marginally changes which refinancings need new 1026.20(a) disclosures; an annual inflation adjustment rather than a new servicing duty.
